title: The finite-rank ell-adic lattice
statement: For a prime $\ell$ and $r\in\mathbf N$, use the p-adic integers $\mathbf Z_\ell$ of [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], with their usual p-adic topology. Define the lattice $L_{\ell,r}=\prod_{i\in\{0,\ldots,r-1\}}(\mathbf Z_\ell,+)$ with coordinatewise addition and the product (equivalently inverse-limit) topology. For use as a group on the profinite site in universe $\mathcal U$, lift this set into $\mathcal U$ and write its additive group multiplicatively, so multiplication is coordinatewise addition. These wrappers change neither the topology nor the group law. The existing total disconnectedness of this finite product is transported along the universe lift. The case $r=0$ is the one-element group.
